title: Kakuriyo -Bed & Breakfast for Spirits- 2
native: かくりよの宿飯 第２期
synopsis:
Aoi—a girl who can see spirits known as ayakashi—was suddenly approached by an ogre. Demanding she pay her grandfather’s debt, Odanna made a huge request: her hand in marriage! Refusing this absurd offer, Aoi decided to work at the Tenjin-ya bed and breakfast to pay back what her family owes. Where we left off, Aoi continues her employment at the Tenjin-ya where even more ayakashi drama ensues and challenges await her.

(Source: Crunchyroll, edited)
